meterCalibration._comments: As reported in Hamlib (strength from measurements by OE1MWW), on the 0-70 dots of Kenwood's TS-990S PC command reference, whose RM is the TS-890S's. Not wired to an entry: the TS-990S has no MD, and its IF carries no transmit flag, so the driver could neither read its mode nor see it keyed.
